Your brain hides unprocessed emotion the way the ocean hides trapped air at the bottom.

Kevin Trudeau says every stray thought you can't shake - the anger, the anxiety, the argument you keep replaying - is energy that got stuck instead of released.

Meditation doesn't empty your mind. It lets those trapped thoughts finally rise, pop and dissolve, the same way a bubble breaks the surface.

The goal was never silence. It's letting the stuck stuff go so it stops running your mood for you.

What's the thought you can't seem to shake?

#kevintrudeau #meditation #mindset #selfimage #mentalhealth #mindfulness

Would you like to have a winning day every day?

Kevin Trudeau used to get flown into Vegas and put up free in mansions with pools built into the living room, where staff were trained to say one thing on the way out: have a winning day.

He started saying it back first - every day a winning day, decided before it starts.

Meditate in the morning and the day runs smoother. Meditate before dinner and the office never makes it through your front door, so your family feels the difference even when you never mention it.

Do you bring the office home with you, or leave it at the door?

#kevintrudeau #meditation #mindset #family #stressrelief #mentalhealth

Twenty minutes sounds like a lot to ask of a busy day, so most people never start.

Kevin Trudeau says the ideal is 20 minutes, but 10 is beautiful, five is great, two is fantastic, and even one full minute still gives you real benefit.

Start there. Five minutes before breakfast is enough to begin. Build up to 15 or 20 over time, or never get there - it still works either way.

"I don't have time to meditate" doesn't hold up once one minute counts.

How many minutes could you actually spare today?
